title: Decaying Sensitivity of the Zero Solution for a Class of Nonlinear Optimal Control Problems
summary: We study spatial decay properties of sensitivities in a nonlinear optimal control problem with a graph-structured interaction topology. For a problem with nonlinear decoupled dynamics and quadratic cost, we show that a perturbation of the zero initial condition at a single node induces an optimal trajectory whose node-wise norms decay exponentially with the graph distance from the perturbed node. The analysis, based on a nonlinear null-controllability condition, provides a first step toward extending known spatial decay results from linear-quadratic to nonlinear systems. A numerical example…
